snippet.title: Stage Fright 1st Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Presenting the first gameplay trailer from Stage Fright, the new co-op adventure from our friends at Ghost Town Games, the tiny team behind the smash-hit kitchen chaos of Overcooked!

You and a friend will immerse yourselves, locally or online, in a strange split-screen saga which requires you to work together to solve escape-room like puzzles, tackle perplexing obstacles together and combine your mental agility to figure out what has happened in this strange town filled with odd characters.

You already know who you're going to play with!

Wishlist here: https://ghosttowngames.com/game/stage-fright/
